data.summary: When this model makes attacks using its twin las-talon against the nearest MONSTER or VEHICLE unit that is an eligible target, each of those attacks gets +1 to its Hit roll.

ability.appliesTo: attacks by this model with its twin las-talon
ability.targetCondition: closest eligible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit
